provenance: M8 sixth tranche: every far record of Ibn Rajab's qawāʿid 3, 9, 14 and 15, annotated against readings formalised from each qāʿida's own statement (Usul.Refinements). Annotated by reading the full paragraph in the pinned witness; every claim of agreement is guarded by Lean (UsulTest/Takhrij.lean); classes and facts await human review (Review.tla).

positions.who: the excess is not obligatory: not caught
the whole is obligatory, or due in following (Ibn ʿAqīl's iḥtimāl): caught

cases.note: Joining the imam in rukūʿ after the minimum has passed: is he counted as catching it in the farḍ? al-Qāḍī and Ibn ʿAqīl build it on the two wujūh; Ibn ʿAqīl's iḥtimāl: the excess counts as due in following alone.

positions.who: a seventh is the due
all is due

cases.note: A camel slaughtered where a sheep is due: all obligatory or a seventh? «على وجهين»; likewise a camel for five camels (al-Qāḍī Abū Yaʿlā al-Ṣaghīr, two wujūh). No madhhab marked.

positions.who: the measure due is farḍ, the rest nafl
the whole is farḍ

cases.note: Wiping the whole head at once where the farḍ is the forelock's measure: all farḍ, or the forelock's measure? The qāʿida's two wujūh; no ruling stated.

positions.who: al-Qāḍī: part is taṭawwuʿ (al-ṣawāb)
Abū al-Khaṭṭāb: all farḍ

cases.note: An older animal than due in zakāt: Abū al-Khaṭṭāb all farḍ; al-Qāḍī part taṭawwuʿ «وهو الصواب ; لأن الشارع أعطاه جبرانا عن الزيادة». The traveller praying four, the whole being originally due, is the other branch («والمذهب الأول»).
Fasting the day of ʿĪd: «فلا يصح بحال على المذهب»; and prayer in the forbidden times.

Prayer in the places of prohibition: invalid on the view that the prohibition is taḥrīm, «هذه طريقة المحققين»; the tashrīq days not valid as a voluntary fast. The second type (a specific condition: prayer with najāsa, without a covering) is likewise invalid.

positions.who: invalid (the ashhar of the two riwāyas)
valid

cases.note: Prayer on usurped ground: the third type, «وفيها الخلاف», with two maʾkhadh for invalidity; the reading takes the qāʿida's «أشهرهما عدمها».

positions.who: the majority: valid
Abū Bakr: invalid

cases.note: Prayer in a usurped or silk turban, or with a gold ring: the fourth type, two wujūh; Abū Bakr: invalid; «وخالفه الأكثرون». Ḥajj with usurped wealth: two riwāyas; Ibn ʿAqīl counts it of the fourth type.

positions.who: riwāya: neither, each on his certainty
riwāya: both, the aṣl having ended in one

cases.note: Two find al-manī in a garment they sleep in, or hear a sound, not knowing whose: two riwāyas; neither must wash («متيقن للطهارة شاك في الحدث»), or both must. Together, one may not lead the other (14.f002).

positions.who: each on the certainty of his marriage
a lot between the two

cases.note: One swears divorce if the bird is a crow, the other if it is not, and it flew off: each builds on the certainty of his marriage (al-Qāḍī in al-Mujarrad, Abū al-Khaṭṭāb), or a lot (al-Shīrāzī, Ibn ʿAqīl; al-Qāḍī in al-Jāmiʿ: «هو قياس المذهب»).

positions.who: a lot, the two now together (aṣaḥḥ al-wajhayn)
each on his certainty

cases.note: The same with two slave-women freed: «قياس المنصوص» that each abstains until certain; if one buys the other's, the freed one is fixed by lot «على أصح الوجهين لاجتماعهما في ملكه», «فينظر إليهما مجتمعين في حكم يتعلق باجتماعهما».
Wetness found on waking, no ghusl (taken as madhy): the garment need not be washed; each keeps its aṣl, «الأصل طهارته فلا ينجس بالشك» (Ibn ʿAqīl from al-Sharīf Abū Jaʿfar).
Doubt whether he wiped the khuff before or after the prayer: the period starts before it and the prayer is repeated, «لأن الأصل وجوب غسل الرجلين والأصل بقاء الصلاة في الذمة».
Game shot and found dead in a little water: not lawful, and the water is not made najis, «بل يستصحب في الماء أصل الطهارة فلا ينجسه بالشك» (Ibn ʿAqīl, al-Fuṣūl).

positions.who: the ḥadd too: the incompatibility is not carried
no ḥadd: the two are incompatible

cases.note: «اعتدي» in anger with signs of accusing her: divorce falls; the ḥadd too? Ibn ʿAqīl's two iḥtimāls: the ḥadd, «لأنهما حقان عليه» (asserted in ʿUmad al-Adilla), or none, «لتنافيهما». The qāʿida's side does not carry the incompatibility.
